- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wine pairing recommendations for paccheri alla vodka:
  - Chianti (medium-bodied, moderate acidity)
  - Valpolicella (medium-bodied, flavors of cherry and plum)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wine pairing recommendations for spaghetti Bolognese:
  - Sangiovese (Chianti, Chianti Classico, Brunello di Montalcino)
  - Barbera (medium-bodied, bright acidity)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] General tips for pairing Italian wine with pasta:
  1. Match the weight of the wine to the weight of the pasta dish.
  2. Consider the sauce.
  3. Pair wines from the same region as the dish.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular Italian wine brands from Tuscany: Antinori, Castello di Ama, Castello di Brolio, San Giusto a Rentennano.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular Italian wine brands from Umbria: Lungarotti, Falesco, Arnaldo Caprai.
